errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.

details.title: Calendar details
details.description: How this calendar appears on the platform, and which time zone its times follow.
details.name: Name
details.typeHint: The type can't be changed after it's created.
details.timeZoneHint: Sending windows, classes and reminders follow this zone's clock, wherever the person is.
details.timeZoneChanged: Working hours, classes and sending windows will follow the new zone's clock. Bookings already made stay at the same moment.

rebalancingHints.day: Upcoming bookings go first to whoever had the fewest today.
rebalancingHints.week: Upcoming bookings go first to whoever had the fewest this week.
rebalancingHints.month: Upcoming bookings go first to whoever had the fewest this month.

notices.title: Team member notices
notices.description: What each team member receives when their schedule changes and before each booking. In-app notifications and WhatsApp messages are independent.

noChannel.title: No connected WhatsApp can send these notices
noChannel.description: They need a connected phone WhatsApp. The official API doesn't work here: it only accepts free-form messages up to 24 hours after the recipient writes, and team members never write first. Until then, only in-app notifications go out.

notices.missingPhone_one: {{count}} team member has no phone number and only gets the in-app notification.
notices.missingPhone_other: {{count}} team members have no phone number and only get the in-app notification.

channel.label: WhatsApp that sends the notices
channel.inherit: Use the channel of the booking's conversation
channel.hint: Only a phone WhatsApp delivers these notices: the official API refuses free-form messages to anyone who hasn't written in the last 24 hours, and team members never write first. With nothing chosen, the notice goes through the channel of the booking's conversation, if it qualifies.
channel.goneHint: The chosen channel is disconnected. In the meantime, the notice tries the channel of the booking's conversation.

channels.whatsappHint: Only reaches people with a phone number on file.

events.title: When a booking changes
events.hint: These notices go out right away. The switches apply as soon as you flip them.

created.title: New booking
created.description: As soon as the booking is created.

eventMessage.label: WhatsApp message
eventMessage.hint: Leave blank to use the default text. The in-app notification has its own wording.

reminder.title: Before the booking
reminder.hint: Scheduled reminders, so the team member can get ready.
reminder.description: Goes out before each of this team member's bookings.
reminder.limit: Each calendar has up to {{max}} reminders.
reminder.messageHint: The same text is used for the in-app notification and for WhatsApp.
reminder.defaultMessage: Reminder: you have a booking with {{nome}} shortly, at {{hora}}.
reminder.silent: With both channels off, this reminder doesn't notify anyone.

empty.title: No team member reminders
empty.description: Create a reminder to notify the team member before each booking.

delete.title: Delete the {{when}} reminder?
delete.description: Upcoming bookings won't get this reminder anymore. Anything already queued still goes out.

reminders.title: Contact reminders
reminders.description: Messages in the contact's conversation, before each booking. Ready-made text is free; the AI costs 1 credit per send.

enabled.label: Send reminders
enabled.hint: When off, nothing goes out, not even what was already scheduled. The rules are kept.

reminders.paused: Reminders are paused. The rules below are kept and apply again when you turn them back on.
reminders.classGroupNote: Reminders apply to bookings with a conversation. Classes don't get reminders.

empty.title: No reminders yet
empty.description: Create a reminder to notify the contact before each booking: fewer no-shows, with nobody having to remember.

reminders.limit: Each calendar has up to {{max}} reminders.

automation.title: When automation is off
automation.description: By default, the reminder only goes out with automation on for both the organization and the conversation: a conversation someone has taken over doesn't get messages on its own.

reactivate.label: Turn automation back on when sending
reactivate.hint: Automation is turned back on in the conversation before the reminder goes out, and flows start replying again.

ignore.label: Send even with automation off
ignore.hint: The reminder goes out anyway, without turning anything back on.

delete.title: Delete the {{when}} reminder?
delete.description: It stops going out right away, including for bookings already queued.

panel.description: Goes out in the contact's conversation, through its channel.
panel.intervalInvalid: Use a whole number, starting at 1.
panel.intervalTooBig: The maximum for this unit is {{max}}.

text.label: Ready-made text
text.description: Free. Whatever you write goes out, with the variables filled in.

ai.label: The AI writes it
ai.description: 1 credit per send. The AI writes it on the spot, from your instruction and the conversation.

rule.messageHint: Variables are filled in with the booking's data, in the calendar's time zone.

messagePlaceholder.reminder: E.g. Hi, {{nome}}! Just a reminder of your {{servico}} on {{data}}, at {{hora}}.
messagePlaceholder.step: E.g. Hi, {{nome}}! We missed you today. Would you like to book another time?

rule.aiPromptRequired: Write the instruction for the AI.

aiPromptHint.reminder: The AI also reads the conversation with the contact, to get the tone right.
aiPromptHint.step: The AI also reads the conversation and can use tools, if the instruction names them.

aiPromptPlaceholder.reminder: E.g. Remind {{nome}} of the {{servico}} on {{data}}, at {{hora}}, in one short, friendly sentence.
aiPromptPlaceholder.step: E.g. Ask {{nome}} how the {{servico}} went and thank them for coming.

fallbackPlaceholder.reminder: E.g. Hi, {{nome}}! Your appointment is on {{data}}, at {{hora}}.
fallbackPlaceholder.step: E.g. Hi, {{nome}}! How did it go?

ifAiFails.reminder: If the AI can't write it (no credits, or it's down), a default reminder goes out. To send your own words instead, fill in the backup text.
ifAiFails.step: If the AI can't write it (no credits, or it's down), this step sends nothing. Fill in the backup text so it isn't lost.
ifAiFails.withFallback: If the AI can't write it (no credits, or it's down), the backup text goes out, for free.

variables.group: Variables to insert in the message

hints.link_reuniao: Insert {{token}}: the Google Meet link, when there is one

notice.text: Nothing is sent or saved, and this test is free.

ai.reminder: Nothing is sent or saved, but generating the preview uses 1 credit. If the AI fails, the credit comes back.
ai.step: Nothing is sent or saved, but generating the preview uses 1 credit. If the AI fails, the credit comes back. Tools only simulate: no field or tag changes.

test.bookingPlaceholder: Search by contact, service or team member
test.bookingHint: The latest bookings in this calendar that have a conversation, with times in the calendar's time zone.

empty.title: No bookings with a conversation
empty.description: The test uses a real booking. When this calendar has a booking linked to a conversation, it shows up here.

history.title: Messages the AI reads
history.hint: The AI writes from the messages checked here.
history.count: {{selected}} of {{total}} checked. The AI reads up to the 30 most recent.
history.empty: This conversation has no messages to use.

result.title: Message preview
result.empty: The message came out empty after filling in the variables.

noCredits.title: No credits to use the AI
noCredits.description: This organization is out of credits. Ready-made text is still free.

busy.title: Another generation in progress
busy.description: This organization already has an AI generation in progress. Wait a few seconds and try again. No credit was used.

failed.title: The AI couldn't write it right now
failed.description: The credit came back. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Conversation out of your reach
notFound.description: This booking no longer exists, or its conversation isn't one you can see.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: This calendar's bookings also appear in a dedicated calendar on your Google account, and what changes there comes back here.
google.notConnected: Choose a Google account. We create the "Vekoo Agendamento" calendar on it, without touching your personal calendar.
google.failedHint: Google refused access. Connect the account again.
google.failedUnavailable: To connect again, this server needs the Google credentials.

unavailable.title: Google Calendar isn't available here
unavailable.description: The Google credentials still need to be set up on this server, which is up to whoever runs the installation. The rest of the calendar works normally.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Google Calendar?
disconnect.description: Bookings stay here. Changes stop going back and forth between the two.

sync.toGoogle: From here to Google: creating, rescheduling, changing the title or description, and canceling. The Meet link shows up on the booking shortly after.
sync.fromGoogle: From Google to here: a new event becomes a booking, without notifying anyone. Changing or deleting a booking there is like rescheduling or canceling here.
sync.scope: We only read the calendar we create on your account, never your personal one.

working.title: Connecting to Google Calendar
working.description: Just a moment, we're checking the authorization.

denied.title: You didn't authorize access
denied.description: The connection only works with your authorization on Google. If that was by accident, start again from the calendar settings.

missingParams.title: This address is incomplete
missingParams.description: The data Google sends back is missing. Start the connection again from the calendar settings.

invalidState.title: This authorization is no longer valid
invalidState.description: It's valid for 15 minutes, and only for whoever started the connection. Start again from the calendar settings.

googleNotStarted.title: The connection wasn't started
googleNotStarted.description: We couldn't find the start of this connection. Start again from the calendar settings.

googleAuthorizationFailed.title: Google didn't accept the authorization
googleAuthorizationFailed.description: This usually happens when the link was already used or has expired. Start again from the calendar settings.

googleConnectionFailed.title: We couldn't reach Google
googleConnectionFailed.description: The authorization arrived, but the connection didn't finish. Try again in a moment, from the calendar settings.

googleNotConfigured.title: Google Calendar isn't available here
googleNotConfigured.description: The Google credentials still need to be set up on this server. The rest of the calendar works normally.

notFound.title: This calendar wasn't found
notFound.description: It doesn't exist in this organization. Check that you're signed in with the right account.

interrupted.title: The connection was interrupted
interrupted.description: The page reloaded before it finished. Start again from the calendar settings.

network.title: Can't reach the server
network.description: Check your connection and try again. Google's authorization stays valid for a few minutes.

generic.title: We couldn't connect
generic.description: Something went wrong along the way. Start again from the calendar settings.

create.title: New calendar
create.description: Start with the basics. You can adjust the rest later, in the calendar settings.
create.typeHint: The type can't be changed after it's created.

professional.label: Team members
professional.description: Each team member has their own schedule, and each booking is with one person.

class_group.label: Classes
class_group.description: Classes with a timetable and enrolled students, with several people attending together.

create.name: Name
create.timeZoneHint: Sending windows, classes and reminders follow this zone's clock, wherever the person is.
create.colorHint: Helps you spot this calendar among the others.

sequences.description: After marking who attended or missed, the conversation gets a series of messages, each at its own time. Ready-made text is free; the AI costs 1 credit per message sent.
sequences.autoEnrollOnlyFirst: More than one sequence here has automatic enrollment. Only the first in the list applies, "{{name}}". The others remain available to enroll by hand.

triggerDescription.show: Goes out after marking that the person attended: say thanks, ask for feedback, suggest the next step.
triggerDescription.no_show: Goes out after marking the no-show: ask if everything is okay and offer another time.

show.title: No sequences for those who attended
show.description: Start with a template or create your own.

no_show.title: No sequences for those who missed
no_show.description: Start with a template or create your own.

manual.title: Enroll someone by hand
manual.description: Without automatic enrollment, enrolling is manual: in the calendar, open the booking and mark attendance. The booking panel offers the sequences for that outcome.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: Anyone enrolled stops getting the next steps. This can't be undone.

changed.title: Someone changed "{{name}}" while you were editing
changed.description: If you save, what the other person did in this sequence is lost. Other sequences don't change.

deleted.title: Someone deleted "{{name}}" while you were editing
deleted.description: Saving creates this sequence again, with what's on the screen. Anyone who was enrolled doesn't come back.

description.show: For those who attended. Goes out after marking that the person came.
description.no_show: For those who missed. Goes out after marking the no-show.

panel.name: Sequence name
panel.stepsHint: Each step goes out some time after the previous one. The first one counts from enrollment.
panel.enrollmentHint: Without automatic enrollment, enrolling is manual, in the booking panel.

hint.show: Once marked as attended, the person enters this sequence without anyone having to choose.
hint.no_show: The person enters this sequence without anyone having to choose.

enabled.label: Sequence on
enabled.hint: When off, nobody new enters. Anyone already enrolled continues to the end.

stopOnReply.label: Stop if the person replies
stopOnReply.hint: The remaining steps don't go out if the contact replies after enrollment.

reactivateAutomation.label: Turn automation back on at each step
reactivateAutomation.hint: Automation is turned back on in the conversation before each message, and flows handle the reply.

ignoreAutomationPaused.label: Send even with automation off
ignoreAutomationPaused.hint: By default, a step only goes out with automation on for both the organization and the conversation. With this option it goes out anyway, without turning anything back on.

attendance_mark.label: When marking the no-show
attendance_mark.hint: The moment someone marks that the person missed.

after_event_end.label: After the booking ends
after_event_end.hint: If nobody marks anything by then, the system marks the no-show and enrolls.

delay.label: How long after the end
delay.hint: This delay only decides when the person is enrolled. Each step's time counts from there: with 5 minutes here and 1 hour on the first step, the first message goes out about 1h05 after the end.

step.name: Step name
step.hasError: Something to fix in this step
step.removeDescription: This step's message is lost when you save the sequence.
step.delayFirst: How long after enrollment to send
step.delayNext: How long after the previous step to send
step.allDayHint: No window: it goes out as soon as the time is up, even in the middle of the night.
step.windowHint: In {{zone}}. Left blank, it's from 8 to 17. Outside the window, the message waits for the next opening.

validation.delayInvalid: Use a whole number, starting at 1.
validation.windowBoth: Fill in both hours, or leave both blank.
validation.windowOrder: The end hour must come after the start.

templates.title: Templates

description.show: For those who attended. Pick one and adjust it before creating.
description.no_show: For those who missed. Pick one and adjust it before creating.

templates.aiNotice: Templates use the AI: each message sent costs 1 credit. If you prefer, switch each step to ready-made text.

tools.title: What the AI can do
tools.description: While writing a step's message, the AI can use these tools. It only uses what the instruction asks for, citing the exact name.
tools.footer: Tools work on every sequence, with nothing to turn on. In a test they only simulate: no field or tag changes.

checkAvailability.name: See open times
checkAvailability.description: Checks the schedule and returns some open times to offer the contact.
checkAvailability.example: Use the check_availability tool to see open times and offer the contact 3 options.

listContactFields.name: Read fields
listContactFields.description: Reads the contact's custom fields, with their current values.
listContactFields.example: Use the list_contact_fields tool to read the contact's fields before writing the message.

setContactField.name: Save field
setContactField.description: Creates or updates a custom field on the contact.
setContactField.example: Use the set_contact_field tool to save the reason for missing in the "missed_reason" field.

removeContactField.name: Delete field
removeContactField.description: Deletes a custom field from the contact.
removeContactField.example: Use the remove_contact_field tool to delete the "time_preference" field.

listTags.name: Read tags
listTags.example: Use the list_tags tool to see the conversation's tags before setting the tone.

addTag.name: Add tag
addTag.example: Use the add_tag tool to add the "wants-to-rebook" tag to the conversation.

removeTag.name: Remove tag
removeTag.description: Removes a tag from the conversation.
removeTag.example: Use the remove_tag tool to remove the "awaiting-rebooking" tag from the conversation.

illustration.message: Hi, Carla! We missed you today. Would you like to book another time?

intro.title: Follow-up that runs on its own
intro.description: Marked that someone attended or missed? The conversation gets the right messages at the right time, without anyone having to remember.

steps.title: Messages in steps
steps.description: Each step goes out some time after the previous one, within the hours you choose. You write the text, or ask the AI to write it.

triggers.title: A follow-up for each outcome
triggers.description: Thank those who attended and win back those who missed, with separate sequences. Enrollment can be automatic, and the sequence stops if the person replies.

start.title: Ready to start?
start.description: Create your first sequence in a few minutes, from scratch or from a ready-made template.
